Nothing OS 5 introduced Collector, a new way to capture the things you like, organise them into visual collections and display them right on your home or lock screen.

Now let’s see what you’ve been collecting 

Coffee, sneakers, tech, figures, cars, food, random things you spot throughout the day - anything goes.

 Share a screenshot of your Collector in the replies and tell us what you’ve been collecting!

I’ll start,

My collection is still pretty small, So far, I’ve added my Fujifilm Instax camera, a photo of my loved one taken with that camera, and a LEGO set I recently won. I’m looking forward to seeing how it grows over time!

Welcome back to another entry into our signature teardown series, we’ve had tear downs for phone switch Glyph Matrixes, our first Ear, and all new audio silhouettes, but today we are bringing you the very first Nothing teardown of a full metal unibody device with Phone (4a) Pro.

Down below you’ll see some new bits, some classic bits, and some bits we had to work around. 

 Display

Phone (4a) Pro’s display is a flagship quality display packing a 144Hz refresh rate into a 6.83” AMOLED panel with 1.5K resolution and 450 PPI that’s protected by Corning Gorilla Glass 7i. Making sure every game of PUBG, rewatch of Interstellar, and scroll down Nothing Community’s latest co-creations feel just as smooth as they are sharp and punchy.

With a peak brightness of 5000 nits in HDR and 1600 nits everywhere else, it’s the brightest display we’ve ever shipped. Ultra HDR photos and videos are given the colour and brightness range they deserve, making every moment clear even when you can’t find a shady spot to check the match score.

Phone (4a) Pro supports a 2500Hz instant touch sampling rate for instant responsiveness, while those who definitely aren’t still scrolling at 2am benefit from 2160Hz PWM dimming to reduce eye strain in low-light.

 Vapour chamber

Our largest ever 5,300mm² vapour chamber cooling system keeps the unibody aluminium midframe cool under pressure. The 5080mAh battery with 50W fast charging fits perfectly over top of the vapour chamber, showing just how well packed in each individual piece is.

 NFC Antenna

The NFC Antenna sits between the battery and the unibody aluminium frame of Phone (4a) pro to take care of all your transit and tap to pay needs.

—

Camera

 Ultra-wide 8 MP ¼” Sony IM355 with 120° field of view

 Front 32 MP ⅓.42” Samsung KD1 with 89° field of view

 Periscope 50 MP ½.75” 3.5X Samsung JN5 with OIS

 Main 50 MP 1/1.56” Sony LYT700c with OIS

—

 Single LED Flash

 Glyph Matrix

Phone (4a) Pro features our flagship-grade Glyph Matrix. Unlike the one in Phone (3), it is built from 137 mini-LEDs. While using fewer lights, it delivers a 57% larger area and is 100% brighter at around 3000 nits, allowing precise display of live notifications, charging status, timers, and more. The lights are sharper and capable of finer detail than previous glyph lights.

 FPC of Glyph Matrix

The FPC or Flexible Printed Circuit board connects the Glyph Matrix to the SOC that powers it.  An FPC is used in tight spaces allowing the electric signals to pass through where they need to.

—

 RF Transceiver

 WCN 6755 Wifi chip

 Snapdragon 7 Gen 4

Built on a 4nm TSMC process, the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 is an 8 core processor capable of up to 2.8 Ghz. Delivering 27% faster CPU performance, 30% improved graphics rendering, and 65% stronger AI capabilities when compared to its predecessor.

Resumen: Este artículo sobre sistematización de experiencia presenta el trabajo realizado dentro del proyecto de acompañamiento socioemocional, desarrollado durante el año 2020 en el contexto del COVID-19 que afectó mayoritariamente a las personas mayores, el cual da cuenta de cómo el aislamiento y las brechas digitales juegan un papel fundamental en la salud física y mental de las personas.

Uno de los cuestionamientos principales es: ¿Cómo el aislamiento y las brechas digitales afectaron la salud mental de las personas mayores en tiempos de pandemia? Para responder a esta interrogante se realizó una investigación cuantitativa, por medio de técnicas como entrevistas, encuestas, registros escritos, talleres, revisión de artículos y seminario.

Los resultados se ven reflejados por medio de llamadas telefónicas realizadas por un grupo de estudiantes en práctica a las personas mayores que participaron en el proyecto, encontrando aquí los efectos negativos que produjo el aislamiento en su diario vivir y las dificultades encontradas por ellos mismos al no saber manejar los medios digitales para poder comunicarse con sus familiares y amigos.

Os materiais fundamentais para participação na Avaliação Contínua da Aprendizagem permanecem disponíveis na seção Avaliações. Do mesmo modo, as funcionalidades para lançamento das respostas e cálculo do desempenho de estudantes permanecem ativas.
